rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the pale-red colour.

example.english: I want to buy the pink shirt.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 fan2 hung4 sik1 go2 gin6 saam1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the pale-red colour.

example.english: This shirt is pink and really suits you.
example.traditional: 呢件衫係粉紅色，幾襯你喎。
example.jyutping: nei1 gin6 saam1 hai6 fan2 hung4 sik1 gei2 can3 nei5 wo3

rows.note: A speaker may use this shorter colour name when the context already makes the pink shade clear.

example.english: I want the pink phone case.
example.traditional: 我想要粉色嗰隻手機殼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 fan2 sik1 go2 zek3 sau2 gei1 hok3

rows.note: Use this for the carnation-type flower meant by a pink, rather than for the colour itself.

example.english: I bought Mum a bunch of pink carnations for Mother's Day.
example.traditional: 母親節我買咗一束康乃馨畀阿媽。
example.jyutping: mou5 can1 zit3 ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 cuk1 hong1 naai5 hing1 bei2 aa3 maa1
